message.content: Now let me understand the vulnerability better. The issue is about a heap-buffer-overflow during DWA decompression where a 16-bit unaligned read can read two bytes past the end of the input buffer. Let me look at the libdeflate library and understand how the malformed compressed data causes this. Let me check the libdeflate version and the specific code.
